css: .diagram-src { left:900px; top:380px; width:340px; box-sizing:border-box; padding:26px 22px; text-align:center } .diagram-src b { display:block; font-size:30px; font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap } .diagram-src span { font-size:25px; color:var(--mute) } .diagram-docs { left:1400px; top:200px; width:360px; box-sizing:border-box; padding:24px 26px } .diagram-dtop { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:14px } .diagram-dtop b { font-size:30px } .diagram-dtop span { padding:5px 14px; border-radius:999px; font-size:22px; font-weight:600; background:var(--jade); color:var(--ground); white-space:nowrap } .diagram-chk { margin:0 0 10px; font-size:29px } .diagram-graph { left:1400px; top:545px; width:360px; height:250px; box-sizing:border-box; background:var(--second); border-color:var(--second) } .diagram-gtop { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; padding:16px 20px 0 } .diagram-gtop b { font-size:28px; color:var(--ground) } .diagram-gtop span { font-size:22px; font-weight:600; color:var(--jade) } .diagram-pill { position:absolute; padding:10px 14px; border-radius:12px; background:var(--tile); border:2px solid var(--hair); font-family:var(--mono, monospace); font-size:24px; color:var(--second); white-space:nowrap; box-sizing:border-box } .diagram-pill.users { height:150px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center }
